units: metres, Blender frame (UE: x*100, -y*100, z*100, yaw = -rot_z)
frame: origin = inside SW corner of the compound at courtyard level; X east 0-44, Y north 0-36 (DOJO_ARENA_SPEC section 1, the same frame as the grey-box layout.json)

M_DKG_SandRaked.orm: R AO, G roughness, B metal

M_DKG_SandEdge.orm: R AO, G roughness, B metal

M_DKG_Granite.unreal: MI of M_DJ_Lib_Opaque (Scripts/dojo/materials/README.md) with the library Granite maps, UseWear on (VertexColor 'Wear'), BaseColor x tint_lin x lerp(warm, cool, frac(PerInstanceRandom * 17.31)) x (1 +- instance_tint)

M_DKG_Gravel.orm: R AO, G roughness, B metal

M_DKG_GravelCoarse.orm: R AO, G roughness, B metal

M_DKG_EdgeTimber.orm: R AO, G roughness, B metal

M_DKG_BedBlend.orm: R AO, G roughness, B metal
M_DKG_BedBlend.unreal: lerp(Gravel, Soil, smoothstep(0.4, 0.6, VertexColor.R + k (0.5 - luminance(Gravel BC))))

M_DKG_Dressing.unreal: BaseColor = VertexColor (the 'Col' layer, linear); no textures; two-sided

M_DJ_GraniteRubble.use: the joint fill under the slab and kerb joints

collision.rule: f1: every hull sits at the visible walk surface: sand, gravel, beds' flat part at 0 (the sand berms rise 7-10 mm over the last 8 cm, visual only); slabs +0.020 (2 cm proud); boards +0.008 (visible top 6-10 mm); gate band +0.10 and bed kerbs +0.05 as boxes; kerb End pieces = convex hull of the sloped block; bed mounds = flat box + convex hull of the dome (gaps in piece_meta). Every step is under the 0.45 m step-up. Rake grooves, gravel and soil relief are normal-map only.
collision.class: Ground, floors (spec 5.3): block Pawn, Camera, Visibility, traversal
collision.dressing: SM_DKG_Tuft_* and SM_DKG_Pebbles_*: no collision (spec 5.3 grass, moss, gravel dressing)
